b: Crispy golden halloumi tossed with ramen noodles in a sticky honey garlic sauce with ginger, soy, sesame oil, and a little chili. Sweet, savory, slightly tangy, and so good!
- Thick soy sauce from the ramen packets
Pat the halloumi dry, coat lightly with cornstarch, and fry in oil until golden and crispy. Set aside.
Mix the thick soy sauce, honey, brown sugar, vinegar, water, sesame oil, seasoning packets, and chili flakes in a bowl.
Boil the ramen until just tender, then drain.
Heat the ramen oil packets in a pan over medium-low heat. Add garlic and ginger and cook until fragrant.
Pour in the prepared sauce and simmer for 2–3 minutes until glossy and slightly thickened.
Add the noodles and toss until coated.
Gently toss in the crispy halloumi.
Finish with sesame seeds and serve immediately!
